notes.title: Update notes 19 Feb 2025
notes.content:
Massively improved shop readability of ship statistics. 

Moved some ship upgrades up to be available earlier. 

Improved ship formations around Carrier, should stay a bit closer and avoid getting stuck on each other better. 

Improved performance slightly, still a work in progress. 

Added functionality to allow newly unlocked resources to be gathered from non-asteroid sources. This should hopefully prevent players from getting stuck on a newly unlocked resource that they can't find because they are just getting unlucky on asteroid drops.

notes.title: Update Notes for 18 Feb 2025
notes.content: Minor bug fixes and description readability.

notes.title: Update notes for 18 Feb 2025
notes.content: Minor patch. Improved shop visibility for quickly identifying upgrades that are affordable and for upgrades that are maxed. Minor bug fixes.
